news.headline: DE Danielle Hunter, LB Azeez Al-Shaair among Texans ruled out vs. Browns
news.description: The Texans will be without a number of key starters -- including running back David Montgomery and All-Pro defensive end Danielle Hunter -- when they travel to face the Browns.

news.headline: Week 10 betting preview: Analysis, best bets, TD predictions for Sunday
news.description: Our experts dive into the odds and player props for Week 10 and offer their betting tips and favorite plays.

news.headline: Sources: Vikings made initial Kirk Cousins trade call to Raiders before MNF
news.description: The Vikings initially reached out to the Raiders about a Kirk Cousins trade before their MNF game against the Bills, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

news.headline: Minter: Lamar Jackson 'doing everything' to return; QB had surgery, sources say
news.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter's update on Lamar Jackson's recovery process calls such timelines "challenging to predict."

news.headline: Patriots are 6-0 after a regular-season loss under Vrabel: Can they do it again?
news.description: New England plays in Munich, Germany, this week. Catch up on what's happening abroad in this week's Patriots notebook.

news.headline: Falcons insist winning still the goal despite trading Jessie Bates III
news.description: Atlanta wanted to ensure trading away Jessie Bates III didn't send the wrong message to the team.

news.headline: Despite Cousins trade, are Vikings back to square one at QB?
news.description: Cousins can give some short-term relief, but his future and the search for a franchise QB remain uncertain.

news.headline: Seahawks are hurting with injuries, but two players will return vs. Raiders
news.description: QB Drew Lock will start again for Darnold. And LB Uchenna Nwosu and WR Rashid Shaheed will return to the field in Las Vegas.

news.headline: Vikings to start reacquired QB Kirk Cousins vs. Packers
news.description: Coach Kevin O'Connell called Kirk Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the Vikings' offense "impressive."

news.headline: 49ers OT Williams, LB Greenlaw questionable, WR Evans out vs. Cowboys
news.description: The 49ers are listing left tackle Trent Williams and linebacker Dre Greenlaw as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, while receiver Mike Evans has been ruled out.

news.headline: When will Lamar Jackson return to the field?
news.description: Jamison Hensley provides an update on Jackson's thumb injury post surgery, projecting a potential return as early as Week 16.

news.headline: NFL outlines steps in Jalen Hurts investigation in letter to senator
news.description: The NFL provided some additional details about the investigation into how Jalen Hurts' blood clots were handled in response to an inquiry from a U.S. senator.

news.headline: Eagles release wide receiver Hollywood Brown per request
news.description: Receiver Hollywood Brown, who has played sparingly over the first half of the season, has been released by the Eagles upon his request.

build.name: Pick Hoarder
build.about: An outsized share of value sits in draft picks.
plan: Picks lose value as the draft nears unless they're early; know which ones to use and which to flip.
Turn late firsts into young players who already produce.
Package several picks to move up for a top-three pick in a strong class.

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
